subjects.description: Workbenches with grey steel drawer cabinets and wooden tops, test machines, grey environmental chambers, steel shelving, rolling utility carts, plastic pails and drums, trash cans, camera tripods, and lab staff in casual clothes walking along the aisle or working at the benches.
subjects.appearance_details: Realistic materials: brushed and painted steel, scuffed plastic, worn wood, cardboard boxes, cables; equipment shows normal signs of use; people move naturally.
subjects.location: Along both sides of a central aisle and in the background
subjects.relative_size: Life-size, seen from about 0.7 m above the floor

background_setting: A modern fabrication and testing laboratory: a large hall with polished grey concrete floor, a central aisle marked by two painted lines, white painted walls, exposed ceiling with ducts, cable trays and long linear LED fixtures, red exit signs.

lighting.conditions: Bright, even overhead LED lighting typical of an indoor laboratory
lighting.shadows: Soft shadows under benches, machines and carts
lighting.illumination_effect: Glossy reflections of the ceiling lights on the polished concrete floor

aesthetics.composition: First-person view from a camera mounted on a wheeled quadruped robot driving down the aisle
aesthetics.color_scheme: Neutral greys and whites with accents of blue, red, orange and green from equipment and containers

cinematography.camera_angle: Low, robot-mounted camera, moving forward smoothly
